# TadaBoo

> Cute stationery, craft kits, squishies and curated gift bags. Thoughtfully packed, lovingly gifted. "Little things that make you go TADA!"

TadaBoo sells stationery and ready-to-gift bags in India. Shoppers pick a ready-made gift bag, or build their own from the shop. Orders can be placed on the website or on WhatsApp.

## What we sell

- Gift bags: 12 ready-made gift bags, priced from ₹199 to ₹999 (Indian rupees, INR). They cover Back to School, return gifts, themed bags for boys and girls, and birthday hampers.
- Shop: 50 products (pens and highlighters, pencils, notebooks and notes, sharpeners and erasers, craft kits, gift sets and squishies).
- Custom bags: items you pick for a custom bag must total more than ₹299. Ready-made gift bags have no minimum.
- Colours, characters or designs may vary with availability. The product type and value always stay the same.

## Delivery and payment

- We deliver anywhere in India, in 7–10 days from your order.
- Orders with items worth ₹999 or more ship free. Smaller orders pay ₹99, or ₹149 to the North East (Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim and Tripura).
- Payment is by UPI, for the order total including delivery.
